envelopeMessage:
Firstly tell me how much did you like this surprise? Okay, you can tell me about it later. Come on,Go ahead...

 Happy birthday to the most important person in my life. Yes, you heard that right. I know we’re going through a rough patch right now, but there is truly no one else I’d rather face it all with. I can never forget how you’ve always been by my side—through my best days and my worst. No matter what I might say when things get overwhelming, you have no idea how deeply I want us to work through this. I really hope we find our way back to each other and figure everything out soon.

Coming back to today, though—I wish you nothing but endless happiness, good health, and the best of luck in everything you do. I genuinely hope you achieve every single dream you’ve ever chased. 

I’m so excited for all the new experiences waiting for us tomorrow, and for every day after that.Happy Birthday once again! ❤️
